title: ReviewReport
description: A periodic PRODUCTION REVIEW over a window of chapters (roadmap 4.6, Publishing OS). ONE schema covers both cadences the North Star names — a 10-chapter VOLUME review (卷末复盘: is this volume holding quality/retention?) and a 30-chapter DIRECTION review (大方向复盘: is the book still on its commercial thesis?) — distinguished by `scope`, so there are not two near-identical stub schemas. It is a deterministic read-side FOLD over the production cards / quality trend / commercial signals already produced for the window; it introduces no new judgment. The DIRECTION scope additionally carries a `market_position_revision`: a concrete PROPOSAL to revise the authored Market Position (4.5) where 30 chapters of production reality diverged from the pre-book thesis — this is the feedback loop that closes Phase 4 (production reality -> revised positioning). Two structural invariants: `gating` const false — a review NEVER blocks a build (ADR-003); `authority` const human — the review only PROPOSES; revising the Market Position and any production-direction change are outward decisions a human makes (ADR-009). The proposal is never auto-written to sources/market-position.yaml. Written to registry/derived/review-report/, NEVER to registry/facts/.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): the review PROPOSES; a human decides whether to act on it (revise positioning, change direction).

gating.description: Structural invariant (ADR-003): a review report NEVER blocks a build; it is advisory read-side aggregation.

scope.description: volume = a ~10-chapter 卷末复盘 (quality/retention health of the block); direction = a ~30-chapter 大方向复盘 (is the book still on its commercial thesis; carries market_position_revision).

window.description: The chapter window this review folded.

target_size.description: The scope's nominal size (10 for volume, 30 for direction); an under-filled window is reviewed as-is and flagged.

summary.description: The deterministic health fold over the window: averaged quality signals, drop-risk, commercial movement, publish-readiness distribution, pacing warnings.

health.description: Synthesized window health, mirroring the dashboard's book_health verdict but scoped to this window.

commercial_pay_movement.description: Sum of per-chapter commercial pay_probability_delta across the window (comparison-only movement).

observations.description: Deterministic human-readable findings (e.g. 'retention trending down across the volume', 'drop-risk elevated in 3 of 10').

market_position_revision.description: DIRECTION scope only. A concrete PROPOSAL to revise the authored Market Position (4.5) where production reality diverged from the pre-book thesis. Never auto-applied — staged for a human (ADR-009). Absent for volume scope, or when no Market Position is authored.

proposed.description: Whether the review found grounds to propose a revision at all.

edits.description: Concrete proposed edits, each pointing at a positioning field with the evidence from production.

field.description: Positioning field to revise, e.g. commercial_promise.sustainability_100 / reader_segment.drop_triggers.

issue.description: How production reality diverged from the authored thesis.

evidence.description: The production signal that grounds this proposal.
